description: The map's messages: the keys by message number from "first" (the numbers before it are common.json's), and the English text of the original game.

strings.map1_s01.statue_of_an_old_mans: Statue of an old man's hand.
strings.map1_s01.the_fist_shut_tight_as:
The fist shut tight,
as if never to let go.{end}
strings.map1_s01.there_is_a_gold_medallion:
There is a {color 2}Gold medallion{/color}.
Take it?{choice 4}
strings.map1_s01.just_the_melted_remains_of:
Just the melted remains of
a statue of a hand.
strings.map1_s01.a_tale_of_birds_without:
{pos 4}{center}{color 3}[A Tale of Birds Without a Voice]

First flew the greedy Pelican,
Eager for the reward,
White wings flailing.

Then came a silent Dove,
Flying beyond the Pelican,
As far as he could.
strings.map1_s01.a_raven_flies_in_flying:
{pos 4}{center}{color 3}A Raven flies in,
Flying higher than the Dove,
Just to show that he can.

A Swan glides in,
To find a peaceful spot,
Next to another bird.
strings.map1_s01.finally_out_comes_a_crow:
{pos 4}{center}{color 3}Finally out comes a Crow,
Coming quickly to a stop,
Yawning and then napping.

Who will show the way,
Who will be the key,
Who will lead to
The silver reward.{end}
strings.map1_s01.it_wont_open_odd_doesnt:

doesn't look locked, though.{end}
